claims.hypothesis: Do other Antennae overlap GMCs besides the Firecracker have properties to form SSCs?
claims.experiment: GESD outlier search plus threshold on mass, radius, pressure, with 3.6 cm ionizing flux check
claims.result: 17 of 72 clumps within uncertainties; only one has significant ionizing flux
claims.finding: 16 likely pre-SSC clouds with intact birth environments

evidence.quote: Of the 72 individual GMCs identified in the overlap region, 17 are within uncertainties of having the necessary mass, pressure, and size needed to form super star clusters (SSCs).

claims.hypothesis: Antennae GMCs differ from GMCs in other environments
claims.experiment: Size-linewidth, Heyer relation, property KDEs and K-S tests across 10 environments
claims.result: Antennae have highest luminosities, surface densities, pressures, wide linewidths, virial parameters among the highest
claims.finding: Antennae resemble galactic centers and some starbursts, unlike normal galaxies

evidence.quote: Compared to other sources in this sample, the GMCs from the Antennae, as well as in other starbursts and in the centers of galaxies, have the highest luminosities, surface densities, and turbulent pressures.

claims.hypothesis: LTE and X_CO mass estimates agree
